description: Generate a complete, custom design system with full token set. Provide a brand color to auto-generate a harmonious palette, pick a style preset, and export as visual HTML documentation, CSS variables, W3C DTCG JSON, Figma Variables, or SVG palette card. The HTML export is a beautiful, self-contained page suitable for sharing with stakeholders. Pass save:true to store the system for reuse by id — this is how a taste-engine session's design system becomes durable.

base_system.description: Start from an existing system as foundation (e.g. 'stripe', 'linear'). Colors will be replaced by brand_color if provided.

brand_color.description: Primary brand hex color (e.g. '#FF6B35'). Auto-generates a full harmonious palette using color theory.

dark_mode.description: Generate dark mode tokens alongside light. Default: true

format.description: Export format: html (visual doc page), css (custom properties), dtcg (W3C JSON), figma (Figma Variables JSON), svg (color palette card), all. Default: html

name.description: Name for the design system (e.g. 'Acme Corp', 'NightOwl')

save.description: Persist the generated token set to ~/.raven/design-systems so its id works everywhere a bundled system's does: base_system here, get_design_system, list_design_systems, and init_design_md. Refused if the id (the slugified name) collides with a bundled system. Default: false

style.description: Aesthetic direction — influences spacing, radii, shadows, motion, and typography. Default: minimal

name: generate_design_system
